provenance.note: IN-GRES 2024-2025 taluka assessment attached to 1502 of 1502 Gram Panchayats across 11 talukas by register membership; 0 deferred with a reason in review[].

limitations: The assessment unit is a revenue taluka, not the Gram Panchayat: each Panchayat inherits its taluka's category and stage of extraction unchanged, as containing-area context rather than a measurement of the place.

Membership is the Local Government Directory's own statement: the taluka the Panchayat's covered villages sit in, joined to the IN-GRES unit by name. No polygon is intersected; a Panchayat whose taluka IN-GRES does not assess is deferred, never guessed.
Blocks are the talukas themselves in this district, so no block spans more than one assessment unit.
